claim: CROSS-FAMILY PATTERN summary of the agentic LLM router (inspect_data=True) across 8 tasks in 4 families. The agent is RELIABLY identifying when more model power is needed, based on data inspection. Pattern: where family memory matches the data (nomad tabular, denoising image-to-image, aerial-cactus binary classification), the agent AGREES with family default; where family memory is incomplete or the data demands more, the agent UPGRADES strategically (opus on code-generation roles, sonnet on judgment, haiku on cheap deterministic).

support.method: Direct python router invocations across families; no cli.py costs

design_finding_summary: The agentic LLM router with inspect_data=True consistently chooses well across 4 task families. When family memory is current and matches reality, the agent agrees. When family memory is STALE OR the data demands more, the agent upgrades — specifically: (a) it pushes opus into code-generation roles (designer, coder, reviser, aggregator) when the task involves complex generation, (b) it keeps sonnet on judgment-evaluation roles (evaluator), (c) it drops to haiku on deterministic cheap roles (judge, selector). This is reliable P1-P7 reasoning. The agent is the RIGHT PRODUCTION CHOICE for unknown tasks; family memory is the right choice for proven tasks where promoting an entry has been done.

production_recommendations.for_known_tasks_with_validated_family_de: Composite router — Static layer answers without LLM cost
production_recommendations.for_known_tasks_with_known_override: Composite router — Static known_override fires without LLM cost (E037 fix required)
production_recommendations.for_unknown_or_stale_family_tasks: router_strategy=llm with inspect_data=True — agent's data-aware judgement is reliable
production_recommendations.for_per_node_dynamic_decisions: router_strategy=llm with inspect_data=True AND per_node_routing=true on tasks where the family default OVER-spends (E029 nomad pattern). NOT on stable tasks (E032 denoising tier drop).
production_recommendations.for_production_cost_safety: Composite as the default strategy. Family memory promotion as the way to amortize LLM router decisions across runs (free after first promotion).

scope: n=1 router query per cell. Pattern across 8 cells across 4 families is the main finding.
limitations: Did not run cli.py to validate agent's choices on dog-breed, spooky-author, jigsaw-toxic — these are predictions, not outcomes.
Did not test what happens when the agent over-upgrades (would cli.py cost balloon vs agent's predicted-better tier?).
confidence: high (8-cell consistent pattern; agent's reasoning is auditable)

implications.loop_synthesis: The autonomous loop has now built a comprehensive picture of routing behavior across 4 families × 2-3 tasks. The Composite router is the production-safe path. The LLM agent is the SMART FALLBACK for unknown tasks. Family memory promotions (E029, E025/E031, E035 policy fix, E042 leaf override) are the amortization channel.
implications.next_experiment_design: Most informative next: validate ONE agent prediction via cli.py — e.g., spooky-author with composite (sonnet-all family) vs LLM-with-data (opus-all). If sonnet-all gold: agent was wrong, family default works. If sonnet-all fails: agent was right, opus needed. Spooky-author is text-classification 60-90min budget.
